thread:
diane: Poking the fallback UX again. We need a lightweight public footprint + full internal auditability. Proposal: always emit tiny "fallback_compact" events with a coarse reason enum and prompt_hash prefix; keep verbose traces sampled for forensic use.

omar: +1. coarse reasons only: latency_quota, model_error, capacity, policy_quarantine. No infra ids in public events.

zara: How about customer experience? Console should show a "fallbacks by reason" overview and let customers request a one-time 24h elevated sampling for debugging (RBAC-gated).

diane: API exposure debate: don't return reason by default. Provide opt-in via header `X-RW-Fallback-Reason: yes` and require account-level consent toggle in Console.

omar: sampling plan: compact events always emitted (tiny). full-trace sample_rate baseline 0.1% per-customer, auto-bump on anomaly windows, emergency gate to avoid costs. Also cap compact events per minute per-customer.

zara: auditability: include prompt_hash + model_version in compact events so we can deterministically replay if regulators request. Keep raw prompts and full traces internal under strict controls and audit logs.

diane: quick compact schema snippet:```json
{"evt":"fallback_compact","cust":"c123","reason":"capacity","route":"text-gen","phash":"a1b2c3d4","mv":"v2","ts":5101239999}
```

omar: ops-bot created INF-1601 for "compact fallback telemetry + consent toggle + replay path" and assigned to @omar and @zara.

zara: next: I'll mock Console panel and consent copy, Omar will draft schema & producer, Diane will coordinate privacy/legal touchpoint. sync in 48h?

diane: yes. goal: minimal public surface, replayable internally, opt-in for richer signals. :thumbsup:
